name: MAG Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，MAG Holdings Berhad 在公告中未披露涉及业务板块扩张、缩减、出售或新合约的具体事项；所披露的公告主要为 recurrent related party transactions、财务年度变更、季度业绩、股东大会及委员会成员变动等。
overview_en: In 2026, MAG Holdings Berhad did not disclose any specific matters involving business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts in its announcements; the announcements were mainly recurrent related party transactions, change in financial year end, quarterly results, general meetings, and changes in committee members.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司披露了在正常业务过程中发生的、未获授权的经常性关联方交易（RRPT），其合计对价在2025年11月27日至2026年11月26日期间超过1%的比率。
actions.text_en: The Company announced recurrent related party transactions (RRPT) entered into in the ordinary course of business which have not been mandated, with aggregate consideration exceeding the 1% percentage ratio for the period from 27 November 2025 to 26 November 2…

actions.text: 公司宣布变更财务年度结束日。
